ci_support_linux_64_.yaml:
DOCKER_PLATFORM:
- linux/amd64
channel_sources:
- conda-forge
channel_targets:
- conda-forge main
docker_image:
- quay.io/condaforge/linux-anvil-x86_64:alma10
python_min:
- '3.11'

about.description:
Optimas is a Python library designed for highly scalable optimization, from
laptops to massively-parallel supercomputers.
Key Features
Scalability: Leveraging the power of libEnsemble, Optimas is designed to
             scale seamlessly from your laptop to high-performance computing
             clusters.
User-Friendly: Optimas simplifies the process of running large parallel
               parameter scans and optimizations. Specify the number of
               parallel evaluations and the computing resources to allocate
               to each of them and Optimas will handle the rest.
Advanced Optimization: Optimas integrates algorithms from the Ax library,
                       offering both single- and multi-objective Bayesian
                       optimization. This includes advanced techniques such
                       as multi-fidelity and multi-task algorithms.
about.summary: Optimization at scale, powered by libEnsemble

name: optimas
raw_meta_yaml:
{% set version = "0.10.1" %}

package:
  name: optimas
  version: {{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/optimas-org/optimas/archive/refs/tags/{{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: aa988e8fa78e789e4c41839dad9d7d7384511f46cce9a6d724cd18d46908c8d1

build:
  number: 2
  noarch: python
  script: {{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv

requirements:
  host:
    - pip
    - python {{ python_min }}
    - setuptools
  run:
    - ax-platform >=1.3.1
    - gest-api >=0.1
    - jinja2
    - libensemble >=1.6.0
    - matplotlib-base
    - mpi4py
    - python >={{ python_min }}
    - numpy
    - pandas
    - pydantic >=2.0

test:
  files:
    - run_test.py
  source_files:
    - examples/
    - tests/
  requires:
    - pip
    - pytest
    - pytest-mpi
    - python {{ python_min }}
  imports:
    - optimas
    - optimas.core
    - optimas.diagnostics
    - optimas.evaluators
    - optimas.explorations
    - optimas.generators
  commands:
    - pip check
    - python run_test.py

about:
  home: https://optimas.readthedocs.io
  license: BSD-3-Clause-LBNL
  license_family: BSD
  license_file: license.txt
  summary: Optimization at scale, powered by libEnsemble

  description: |
    Optimas is a Python library designed for highly scalable optimization, from
    laptops to massively-parallel supercomputers.
    Key Features
    Scalability: Leveraging the power of libEnsemble, Optimas is designed to
                 scale seamlessly from your laptop to high-performance computing
                 clusters.
    User-Friendly: Optimas simplifies the process of running large parallel
                   parameter scans and optimizations. Specify the number of
                   parallel evaluations and the computing resources to allocate
                   to each of them and Optimas will handle the rest.
    Advanced Optimization: Optimas integrates algorithms from the Ax library,
                           offering both single- and multi-objective Bayesian
                           optimization. This includes advanced techniques such
                           as multi-fidelity and multi-task algorithms.
  dev_url: https://github.com/optimas-org/optimas

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - AngelFP
    - ax3l
    - RemiLehe
    - shuds13
